product_overview: The Quiet Archive is a multi-tenant, role-based knowledge workspace that lets teams create and organize Markdown notes, manage tasks, and schedule calendar events scoped to workspaces with real-time sync and admin management features.
core_goals: Create, edit, and organize Markdown notes scoped to a workspace
Manage task lists and mark work items complete (admin+)
Manage workspaces and team membership (admin+), and manage users (admin+ / super_admin)
Configure account preferences and API keys via Settings
See real-time updates across active sessions

features.name: Setup Account
features.description: First-run flow to create the initial super_admin account and bootstrap the default workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /setup -> Fill email, password (>= 8 chars), and display name -> Submit setup form -> Be logged in and see the dashboard at /
Navigate to /setup -> Fill email with weak password (< 8 chars) -> Submit setup form -> See validation error about password length
After setup completed, Navigate to /setup -> Observe redirect to /login

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See dashboard at /
Navigate to /login -> Fill email with non-existent account -> Fill password -> Submit -> See authentication error
Navigate to /login -> Submit empty credentials -> See validation error

features.name: Dashboard & Notes
features.description: Browse workspaces and create, search, and manage notes scoped to the currently open workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a workspace from the sidebar -> Create a new note with title and Markdown content -> Wait idle for 2 seconds -> See note saved and listed in the workspace
Navigate to / -> Open a workspace from the sidebar -> Open an existing note -> Edit content -> Wait idle for 2 seconds -> See updated content persisted
Navigate to / -> Type a query in the global search -> See note list filter in real-time by title (case-insensitive)

features.name: Markdown Editor (line-based)
features.description: Edit notes using a Typora-style per-line editor with live preview and line-level editing behaviors.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a workspace from the sidebar -> Open a note -> Enter edit mode for a line and type "# Hello World" -> Blur the line -> See the line rendered as an H1 in preview
Navigate to / -> Open a workspace from the sidebar -> Open a note -> Edit a line to include "**bold** and *italic*" -> Blur the line -> See bold and italic styling in preview
Navigate to / -> Open a workspace from the sidebar -> Open a note -> Create a line "- [x] Done" -> Blur the line -> See a checked task checkbox rendered in preview

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Create and update tasks scoped to a workspace. Access is restricted to admin+ roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /tasks -> Create task with title and workspace selection -> See new task listed with status = "todo"
Navigate to /tasks -> Select a task -> Change task status to done -> See task status updated to done
Login as a regular user -> Navigate to / -> Observe Tasks not present in sidebar nav -> Attempt to open /tasks -> See access denied or tasks page not visible

features.name: Calendar
features.description: View and (for admin+) create calendar events scoped to a workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> See the list or grid of events for the active workspace
Navigate to /calendar (as admin) -> Create an event with start and end times -> See the new event appear in the calendar view
Login as a regular user -> Navigate to / -> Observe Calendar not present in sidebar nav -> Attempt to open /calendar -> See access denied or calendar page not visible

features.name: Workspace Management
features.description: Admins can create and manage workspaces and add members; super_admin can delete workspaces.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Open Workspaces tab -> Create a workspace with a name -> See new workspace appear in the workspaces list and in the sidebar
Navigate to /settings -> Open Workspaces tab -> Add a member to a workspace -> See member listed in workspace membership
Login as regular user -> Navigate to /settings -> Observe Workspaces tab not visible

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admin-level flows to create and manage users and their assignment to default workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Open Users tab (admin) -> Create a new user with valid email -> See user added and assigned to General workspace
Navigate to /settings -> Open Users tab -> Attempt to create user with invalid email -> See validation error
Login as regular user -> Navigate to /settings -> Observe Users tab not rendered

features.name: Settings & API Keys
features.description: Profile and application settings including theme persistence and API key generation for admin+ users.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Open Profile tab -> View display name and email -> Observe role badge matches account role
Navigate to /settings -> Open Profile tab -> Change theme -> See theme update immediately and persist after reload
Navigate to /settings -> Open API Keys tab (admin) -> Generate API key -> See API key displayed once and listed in keys table
Navigate to /settings -> Open API Keys tab (admin) -> Revoke an API key -> See the key removed from list

features.name: Navigation & UI
features.description: Primary navigation behaviors including sidebar workspace expansion, profile menu, and mobile responsiveness.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the workspace sub-list in the sidebar -> See the sub-list expand and collapse
Navigate to / -> Open the profile dropdown -> See Theme, Settings, and Sign out options displayed -> Click outside -> See the dropdown close
Viewport < 768px -> Navigate to / -> Open the hamburger menu -> See the sidebar slide in with overlay

features.name: Real-time Synchronization
features.description: Live updates propagate to other active user sessions (notes, tasks, calendar) via real-time channels.
user_flows: Open the app authenticated in Browser A and Browser B -> In Browser A edit a note and wait for auto-save -> See the edited note update in Browser B without manual refresh
Open the app authenticated in Browser A and Browser B -> In Browser A create or update a task or calendar event -> See the new or updated item appear in Browser B in real-time

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with email and password credentials
